host.isolation: none: shared host, load average 37-165 during the runs; wall figures are contended and secondary

fixtures: public registered Koblitz K_0 rungs n=23 (icv1-f2m23-t5197-69e76b73), n=31 (icv1-f2m31-tm90707-c95f16f5), n=41 (icv1-f2m41-tm2308219-7f48b14a); targets [a]G for seeded a; compact-orbit-scan base with K columns

units.s3_solves: quadratic S3(x_R, x_s, X) root solves (the ladder unit)
units.s4_solves: quartic S4(x_R, x_s1, x_s2, X) root solves over F_{2^n} (kernels B, B2)
units.outer_probes: first-summand probes, the feasibility note §4.7 unit: S3 solves for the 4-sum, outer states s1 for kernel A, base points P_e for kernel C, S4 solves for kernels B/B2
units.targets: targets handed to the kernel; every relation counted was re-added in the fast and the general arithmetic

models.note_4sum: r/(n^2 K^2) (RESEARCH_ECC2K130_IC_FEASIBILITY.md §2, probes per relation, fit C in [0.33, 1])
models.note_6sum_47: 45 r/(n^4 K^4) (§4.7, first-summand probes per relation assuming an S4 oracle over all (s2, s3) pairs)
models.structural: scan_unit × (e^{-λ}/(1-e^{-λ}) + 1/(μλ+1)) with the hit-or-miss scan unit, its relation rate λ and multiplicity μ per kernel; asymptotes r/(4A) [S3] or r/(8A) [S4] (dense) and scan_unit/λ (sparse); A = abscissa states, λ4 = B^4/(24 r), λ6 = B^6/(720 r), B = base points

producer_versions.1: raw/n41_k*.json, n41_k5_*_long.json: kernels 4sum, a, b, c; no derived structural fields beyond models.* (derived here under .structural)
producer_versions.2: raw/n41_k*_b2.json: same measurement code as v3, derived fields differ
